robust_logic_failure.finding: All three second-week trades reached the scenario structural stop before the frozen target.
robust_logic_failure.reason: Increasing the stop reserve or reducing quantity would reduce PnL magnitude but each scenario would remain a losing structural-stop outcome.

risk_model_failure.finding: One native stop fill exceeded the causal Q99 stop-slippage reserve and the three-percent signal-time loss budget.
risk_model_failure.interpretation: This is a separate baseline risk-contract failure; it does not rescue the already-negative scenario logic.

third_frozen_btc_week.reason: The family was terminally rejected after an implementation-clean first-week pass followed by a zero-win, three-structural-stop second week plus a realized-loss-budget violation.

preregistered_location_ablation.reason: The losing second-week trades already passed the source-session-half location rule; removing that rule cannot change their stop-before-target outcomes and was not the dominant rejection cause.
